title: Emit experiment_id/variant_id in OTel spans + scoped metric tags (cardinality-safe)
author: Logan Wright
description: Context: Route-level experiments need first-class attribution across traces and key service metrics so Console and dashboards can slice by {route, experiment_id, variant}. This PR plumbs experiment_id + variant_id into OpenTelemetry spans and adds a controlled/sampled mechanism for tagging a small set of metrics without blowing up cardinality. What’s included: (1) Span attributes: emit `redwood.experiment_id` and `redwood.experiment_variant_id` on request root spans (gateway/router) and service spans that already carry route_id/model_id; also include `redwood.experiment_assignment_source` (sticky_key|header_override|fallback) for debugging. (2) Metrics tagging: add experiment tags to a whitelist of high-value metrics only (latency histogram, request count, error count, token count/cost), leaving the rest untouched; includes a guard that drops experiment tags when variant is unknown. (3) Sampling: for metrics, experiment tags are emitted at 100% for low-cardinality routes (<= configured route allowlist) and at a configurable sampling rate elsewhere; sampling is deterministic per (route_id, stickiness_key_hash) to avoid time-window skew. (4) Safety: hard caps on variant_id length, normalization to stable IDs (no raw names), and a runtime knob to disable experiment tagging globally (`RWD_EXPERIMENT_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false`) for emergency rollbacks. References: ADR-048 (metrics attribution schema) and ongoing ENG-9022/ENG-9024 work that produces experiment assignment in request context. Notes: This intentionally does NOT add experiment tags to all OTel metrics instruments. The default is ‘spans always, metrics scoped + sampled’ per SRE cardinality review. Testing: unit tests for attribute propagation and sampling determinism; local validation via `otelcol` and staging dashboard queries.
commits: otel: add experiment fields to RequestContext + span enricher
metrics: introduce experiment tag whitelist + deterministic sampler
router: propagate experiment assignment source + normalize IDs
tests: add coverage for streaming/retry span propagation
docs: add internal note on cardinality + knobs
review_conversation: Allison Grant: Please confirm the exact attribute keys we’re standardizing on. We should not ship `experimentId`/`variantId` camelCase in spans; align with existing `redwood.*` conventions. Also, can we ensure we never emit raw variant names to avoid accidental PII / customer naming leakage?

Logan Wright: Updated to `redwood.experiment_id` + `redwood.experiment_variant_id` and added normalization to stable IDs. Also capped lengths and added explicit redaction/normalization notes in the internal doc.
Sean Gallagher: Cardinality concerns: tagging histograms is expensive. What’s the worst-case route*experiment*variant fanout, and what’s our kill switch story if staging falls over again?

Logan Wright: Metrics tagging is restricted to a whitelist (4 instruments) and is deterministic-sampled by (route_id, stickiness_key_hash) outside the allowlist. Added `RWD_EXPERIMENT_TELEMETRY_ENABLED` global disable and `RWD_EXPERIMENT_METRICS_SAMPLE_RATE` knob. Spans are un-sampled at this layer but still respect existing trace sampling upstream.

Caleb Johnson: Where do these attributes land in the OTel pipeline? Are we mapping them into metrics exemplars or just span attributes? Also please add a test for streaming retry path so experiment attrs don’t drop on retry spans.

Logan Wright: Currently span attributes only + metric labels for whitelisted instruments; no exemplar mapping in this PR. Added streaming retry test to ensure attrs persist through retry middleware (and confirmed in local otelcol output).

Jordan Lee: Deterministic sampling hash input should use the same stable stickiness key hash we use for bucketing; otherwise we’ll get weird mismatches between assignment and metrics sampling. Also: if stickiness key is missing, what’s the behavior?

Logan Wright: Sampling uses `assignment.sticky_key_hash` when present; otherwise uses a request-id-derived hash (best-effort) but only for spans (metrics tags dropped when stickiness key missing unless route is allowlisted). Added a comment + TODO to revisit once ENG-9022 ships default stickiness precedence.

Chloe Martin: Minor: please ensure the Console results API can rely on these fields being present in router spans. Can we add them to the top-level gateway span specifically and not just downstream spans?

Logan Wright: Done—added attributes to the gateway root span and kept propagation to downstream spans that already attach route/model. Added note in docs so Console/analytics can key off the root span for attribution integrity.
release_notes: Internal: Route experiment attribution now present on OTel traces (`redwood.experiment_id`, `redwood.experiment_variant_id`) and on a limited/sampled set of metrics to support guardrail dashboards without high-cardinality blowups.
